## JavaScript API

Defaults to `false`. If `true`, include a silent audio track when the render contains no audio. If `false`, omit the audio track when no audio is present. Audio-only exports and `separateAudioTo` still produce an audio file, even when silent.

Set this to `true` for [chunks that will later be concatenated](/docs/distributed-rendering), because other chunks may contain audio. `muted: true` takes precedence.

## Command line

Defaults to `false`. If `true`, include a silent audio track when the render contains no audio. If `false`, omit the audio track when no audio is present. Audio-only exports and `--separate-audio-to` still produce an audio file, even when silent.

Pass `--enforce-audio-track` for [chunks that will later be concatenated](/docs/distributed-rendering), because other chunks may contain audio. `--muted` takes precedence.

## CLI flag

```text
--enforce-audio-track
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#enforceaudiotrack)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#enforceaudiotrack)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#enforceaudiotrack)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setEnforceAudioTrack(true);
```
